required_evidence_floors.requirement: A replayable basis lock must pin the reviewed decision inputs.
A pinned knowledge pack must exist for the selected starter set or candidate.
The packet must state target and support posture explicitly.
The packet must state the effective MSRV or toolchain floor and known drift caveats.
The packet must identify whether the dependency is intended to be long-term, wrapped, or later replaced.

non_claims: This profile is not a certification.
A pass does not prove compliance with any specific safety standard.
Trusted publishing and docs visibility do not by themselves prove task fit.
